price_model: One frictionless matched-delivery forward, normal independent settlement shock. EUR/MWh.
physical_risk: Reference pricing law uses simulated operational probabilities with zero markup for volume risk.
exposure: At gate closure available volume for one 4 MW quarter-hour request is fixed, reserved and bounded by 1 MWh. Customer has a call per available MWh.
premium: Primary hedging comparison uses one common quote: training mean volume times Bachelier unit premium.
assessment: Predict delivered MWh, multiply by unit call price for quote, by normal delta for forward holding. Score quotes against full-state scenario values and compare exact conditional terminal MSE integrated over price and averaged on independent histories. All test observations retained.
